text:
Type: textured tassel throw blanket
Use: layering on an armchair, sofa or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: bohemian, rustic, contemporary
Materials: woven cotton with ribbed texture, twisted rope tassels
Colors: cream, natural off-white
Shape: rectangular throw, horizontal ribbed bands, thick twisted rope fringe with knotted tassel ends, chunky and substantial
Feel: earthy, crafted, warm, relaxed
Goes with: cognac leather, warm wood, black and white rugs; bohemian, rustic or mid-century rooms

product.name: Rivet Modern Global-Inspired Textured Tassel Throw Blanket
product.description: This throw is a comfy, functional work of art. Inspired by archaelogical finds in Mexico's Tulum ruins, it features layers of texture and oversized, hand-tied tassels. Use on a bed, drape over your sofa or hang on the wall for a true style statement. 50"W x 60"L 100% cotton Spot clean only.
